original_claim: Detector-aware rewriting did not help the attacker; it usually hurt (condensation) [results/t3/REPORT.md, EXPERIMENT_LOG 'T3 results', PDF 03]
corrected_claim: Superseded. Round 1 had no rewrite-only control, so the aware-minus-original drop mixes detector-aware strategy with the cost of LLM rewriting itself; the strategy effect is not identifiable under the round-1 monitor (gpt-4.1-mini). Round 2's rewrite_control shows that rewriting alone costs about -0.36 undetected-success vs max (gpt-4.1 none). Re-expressed against that rewrite-only reference (gpt-4.1 none; control from the round-2 pipeline, so only approximate), the round-1 aware arms are not worse than a plain rewrite; point estimates favour the aware arms (+0.06 to +0.14 vs max, one-shot +0.06 to +0.10; 3 of the 6 joint CIs exclude 0, all in the attacker's favour). The drop is not evidence that detector-aware strategy hurts.

original_claim: Validity: judge preservation 98-99%, literal preservation 0.88-0.90; 'Undetected-success drops are genuine detection, not broken attacks'
corrected_claim: valid = LLM judge only (gpt-4.1-mini, reading fabricated outputs). 0.88-0.90 is the mean literal fraction; only about 80% of adaptive (72-80% of one-shot) rewrites are judge-valid AND keep every target literal. Requiring the literals lowers every aware level by a further 0.17-0.20 at max, so part of the drop is plausibly broken attacks, not detection. The 'genuine detection' sentence is dropped; levels are reported as [strict, judge] bounds.

original_claim: Adaptive (2 feedback rounds) beats one-shot by +0.10..+0.17 undetected-success on the matched diagonal
corrected_claim: Holds in full mode with joint CIs and strict validity, but it is an in-sample oracle selection gain (the feedback used the same gpt-4.1-mini full-mode scores and threshold as the evaluation), not out-of-sample attacker capability. In none mode (not the feedback mode) the gain is +0.03 to +0.08.

corrected_claim: Conclusion holds, but the fit range was wrong: with 550 honest runs no threshold is calibratable above ARL ~551 (conformal threshold +inf, damage flat by construction). Re-fit on ARL <= 551 only, slopes stay far below 0.5.
